headline: MIA @ MIN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIA 5.47 at MIN 3.52, with a projected total of 8.99. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: MIA moved +1.31 runs while MIN moved -0.81, changing the projected margin by +2.11 runs. The projected total climbed +0.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Max Meyer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Ryan Jeffers, Byron Buxton, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christopher Morel, Esteury Ruiz because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
